market_window_rule.principle: Evidence discipline prevents waste, not speed.
market_window_rule.action: Validation and selling may proceed in parallel. Preparation is limited to validation materials, manual delivery design and, only under the decision engine's commercial-build exception, a minimum technical prototype. This does not authorize MVP or production build before the applicable evidence gate.

project_specific_gates.rule: Add only verified project-specific legal, security, integration or delivery gates.
